        t = int(data[idx]); idx+=1

        d = int(data[idx]); idx+=1

    for i, (arr, size, dur) in enumerate(groups):

        # Seats used = groups currently dining
        # Need to find when cumulative freed seats allow size more
        
        # Build timeline of seat availability
        # At time t, seats_used = sum of groups dining at time t
        # seats_free = 17 - seats_used
        
        # Try time = max(arr, previous group's seated time if sequential)
        # Actually groups seated in order, so group i can't be seated before group i-1
        
        min_start = arr if i == 0 else max(arr, seated_time[i-1])
        
        # Find earliest time >= min_start when free seats >= size

import sys
import heapq

def waiting_time_for_nth_group(n: int) -> int:
    # Seats in the restaurant
    SEATS = 17

    # Priority queue of leaving times for seated groups:
    # (leave_time, seats_used)
    leaving = []

    occupied = 0

    # Generate groups in order until the n-th group appears.
    # We interpret "n-th group" as 0-indexed because n ranges from 0 to 99.
    for i in range(n + 1):
        # Arrival time, group size, dining duration
        arrival = 5 * i
        group_size = (i % 5) + 1
        duration = 17 + (i % 3) * 3

        # Free seats from groups that have already left by arrival time
        while leaving and leaving[0][0] <= arrival:
            t, s = heapq.heappop(leaving)
            occupied -= s

        start = arrival

        # If not enough seats, wait until enough groups leave
        if occupied + group_size > SEATS:
            temp = []
            while occupied + group_size > SEATS:
                t, s = heapq.heappop(leaving)
                occupied -= s
                start = t
                # Also free every group leaving at the same time
                while leaving and leaving[0][0] == t:
                    tt, ss = heapq.heappop(leaving)
                    occupied -= ss

            # no need for temp; all popped groups have left

        wait = start - arrival

        # Seat this group
        occupied += group_size
        heapq.heappush(leaving, (start + duration, group_size))

    return wait


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return

    ans = []
    for x in data:
        n = int(x)
        ans.append(str(waiting_time_for_nth_group(n)))

    print("\n".join(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
